desc: Implement initial local-rewrite DP and brute checker; sample passed but hidden counterexample found.
Disprove local-rewrite model with counterexample [1,2,1,3,2,3] (exact 5, current DP 6).
Implement new O(N) DP with zero-cost Z moves and P moves on run sequences (right-move chain DP), run on original and reversed runs, answer = M - max reward.
Validate the new DP by running the built-in exhaustive self-test (`python program.py test`) and regression cases; fix any mismatches.
Finalize stdin solver with fast I/O and ensure the test harness is not run by default.
